verdict.rationale: Gusto's own 'intelligent payroll automations' gather hours and flag anomalies ahead of payroll, leaving the owner a quick review and sign-off. That is a first-party background automation, but it is fixed to payroll rather than user-configurable. The pre-payroll agent prep works through external agents connected via MCP, and every change is gated on owner approval, so the evidence shows built-in assistance rather than automations a user sets up to run autonomously. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduling or triggers beyond payroll, truly autonomous execution without per-change approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
